messages:
amy: Quick design question — for the project-level spend card should we show a tiny sparkline (compact glance) or a stacked token-breakdown bar (explicit split)? I put two mocks in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/project-spend-mocks
vikram: I lean sparkline for glanceability, stacked for when folks need the token-type split. Stacked eats vertical real estate tho. :thinking:
leo: eng note: stacked bars are simpler perf-wise. Sparklines need a short timeseries endpoint but nothing crazy. Either is fine from infra side.
maria: accessibility: stacked bars are easier to narrate if each segment has an aria-label. Sparklines need a concise alt summary like "up 12% vs last 30d". Color contrast on thin segments will be an issue.
amy: good call. UX-wise what about defaults? org-level vs project-level? I'm thinking org defaults to stacked (people want breakdowns at org level), project defaults to sparkline with a small token legend beneath.
vikram: +1. Also propose an interactive compact mode: sparkline by default, tap/hover expands into stacked breakdown inline. That keeps default density low but gives drilldown.
leo: can the expand be client-side only? prefer avoid extra backend calls for every hover. We can cache breakdowns per session.
maria: keyboard/voice: ensure expand is tabbable and announces "expanded token breakdown"; when collapsed, announce "collapsed — press enter to view breakdown". Also ensure color-blind friendly palette and pattern fills for tiny segments.
amy: another convo: invoice CTA placement. Current mock puts "Download invoice" on the org header top-right. For projects it sits in the kebab menu. Thoughts?
vikram: consistency favors header-level CTAs, but per-project menus are cleaner if we want to avoid clutter. Maybe header for org, menu for project.
leo: implementationally menu is simpler for projects. Header download for org-level ties into billing flow.
amy: agree. Copy nit: prefer "Download invoice (CSV)" or "Download invoice (PDF)" to set expectations.
maria: and aria-labels like "Download invoice, PDF, opens in new tab" when relevant.
vikram: I'll iterate the mock with compact-expand interaction, stacked default for org, and the revised download copy.
leo: I'll spin up a quick prototype branch: `feat/spend-card-compact` and wire the expand toggle.
amy: action items: vikram — updated mock; leo — prototype branch & perf check; maria — accessibility checklist for token breakdowns; amy — sync with PM on copy.
amy: tagging @design-bot for diffs
design-bot: visual-diff created: https://ci.internal/artifacts/1823459999/diff.png :white_check_mark:
vikram: thanks — will post updated frames by EOD.
leo: pushed preliminary PR, includes keyboard toggle and cached breakdown payload. Link in thread soon.
amy: perfect. We'll move to a formal review in #product-design after those updates. :rocket:
